title: PX4_SIH_SITL mode
current_gap: The fixed PX4's SIH mode and interface are unchecked; unique physics authority and time remapping are unverified; the current external-physics SITL does not cover this mode.

atoms.name: sih_mode_availability
atoms.required: The pinned PX4 build's SIH mode existence and interface verified in source

atoms.name: unique_physics_authority
atoms.required: Exactly one physics authority; with SIH the FC-internal model is authoritative and no second physics core runs

atoms.name: time_remapping
atoms.required: Display/mission time remapped onto the FC-internal timeline instead of a second physics clock

atoms.name: interface_contract
atoms.required: SIH interface map (state, actuators, sensors) pinned per message/field

atoms.name: external_sitl_distinction
atoms.required: Rule enforced: external-physics SITL evidence never covers SIH modes

scope_rule: in SIH the flight-controller-internal model is the only physics authority; external-physics SITL evidence is a different mode
